title: Trump administration seeks to cut food aid for more than six million people
paragraphs: The administration of United States President Donald Trump has proposed new eligibility requirements for the country’s largest food aid programme that would see some 6.3 million people removed from it.

The US Department of Agriculture (USDA) published a proposed rule (PDF) on Tuesday that would end automatic eligibility in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), doing away with current provisions that automatically make households eligible for the programme if they meet state-administered requirements for another programme, called Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF).

“These revisions would ensure that SNAP benefits are targeted to needy households that have qualified for TANF assistance while still aligning categorical eligibility’s statutory purpose of simplifying program administration,” the agency said in the proposal, which will be open to public comments for 30 days.
